a-propos.title: About ORAYA Maison
a-propos.intro: Born in Abidjan, ORAYA Maison celebrates the radiance of Ivorian women — and all women who love to shine, gracefully.

p: ORAYA Maison was born from a simple belief: every woman deserves jewelry worthy of her radiance, with no compromise on quality or price.
From Abidjan, we select every piece with rigor: 18k gold plated, 925 silver, stainless steel — durable, tarnish-resistant materials designed for a tropical climate.
Jewelry you can wear every day without taking off, delivered within 24 to 48h across Abidjan, in a case worthy of a gift — even when you're the one treating yourself.
And because every story is unique, our workshop also creates custom jewelry: name pendants, photo lockets and engraved bracelets.
Every order arrives in our signature case: an emerald green box trimmed with a gold ribbon, a protective pouch and a certificate card. Ready to give, ready to move.

livraison-paiement.title: Shipping & payment
livraison-paiement.intro: Fast delivery in Abidjan and across Côte d'Ivoire, payment by mobile money, card or cash on delivery.

p: Abidjan (all communes): 24 to 48 business hours — free shipping from 50,000 FCFA, otherwise 1,000 FCFA.
Inside the country: 2 to 5 days — 2,500 FCFA. International: on request via WhatsApp.
Wave, Orange Money, MTN MoMo, Moov Money, Visa/Mastercard — or cash on delivery within Abidjan.
You receive a payment request on your phone as soon as your order is confirmed.
At every step, our team keeps you informed on WhatsApp: confirmation, preparation, handover to the courier, delivery.

cgv.title: Terms & conditions
cgv.intro: These terms govern sales made on the ORAYA Maison website.

p: Every order placed on orayamaison.ci is confirmed by WhatsApp or phone. The order becomes final once payment (or cash-on-delivery agreement) is validated.
Prices are shown in CFA francs (XOF), all taxes included. EUR and USD conversions are provided for guidance only.
Payments are accepted via Wave, Orange Money, MTN MoMo, Moov Money, Visa/Mastercard, or cash on delivery within Abidjan.
The announced times (24–48h in Abidjan) run from order confirmation. A delivery delay cannot give rise to cancellation or compensation beyond refunds provided for by Ivorian law.
You have 7 days after receipt to request an exchange of a non-customized jewel, in its original case and unworn.
Custom jewelry (name, photo, engraving) is excluded from the exchange policy, except for manufacturing defects.
Our jewelry is guaranteed for 1 year against manufacturing defects and abnormal tarnishing, excluding normal wear, shocks and exposure to sea water or chemicals.

confidentialite.title: Privacy policy
confidentialite.intro: Your data belongs to you. We protect it and use it solely to process your orders.

p: Name, phone number, delivery address and order history — only what is necessary to deliver and serve you.
Your data is used to process your orders, keep you informed of their tracking and, with your consent, share our news on WhatsApp.
We do not sell or transfer your data to third parties for commercial purposes.
You may request access, correction or deletion of your data at any time by writing to us on WhatsApp or by email.

entretien.title: Jewelry care
entretien.intro: A few simple steps to keep your ORAYA jewelry shining, year after year.

p: Last thing in the morning, first thing at night: remove your jewelry before showering, swimming or working out.
Avoid contact with perfumes, creams and household products — put your jewelry on after your beauty routine.
Once a month, let your pieces soak for a few minutes in warm soapy water, brush gently with a soft toothbrush, rinse and dry with a microfiber cloth.
To revive the shine of gold-plated pieces, rub gently with a gold polishing cloth.
Store each piece in its ORAYA pouch, away from humidity and direct light.
Separate your jewelry to avoid scratches: chains tangle, stones chip.

guide-tailles.title: Ring size chart
guide-tailles.intro: Find your size in three minutes, without leaving home.
how: Wrap a strip of paper or string around the base of your finger.
Mark where the strip crosses, then measure the length in millimeters: that's your circumference.
Match it in the table below to find your ORAYA size.
Between two sizes? Choose the larger one, especially for a wide band.
tips: Measure your fingers at the end of the day, when they are slightly swollen.
Fingers change with heat: avoid measuring cold hands.
For a surprise gift, discreetly borrow an existing ring and measure its inner diameter.

guide-cadeaux.title: Gift guide
guide-cadeaux.intro: The perfect jewel exists — here's how to find it for the one you love.

p: Does she wear discreet pieces or statement jewelry? Gold or silver? Take note: that's your first compass.
In doubt, fine gold chains and classic pendants are safe bets.
Birthday: her custom name pendant. Declaration: a heart or a star. Wedding: the necklace-and-earrings set.
Christmas or Mother's Day: our emerald green case always makes an impression.
Under 15,000 FCFA: delicate rings and pendants. Around 25,000 FCFA: signature necklaces and bracelets. Over 50,000 FCFA: sets and custom jewelry — with free shipping.

astuces-style.title: Style tips
astuces-style.intro: Layer, mix, dare: our stylist tips to compose your jewelry looks.

p: The golden rule: three different lengths (40, 45 and 50 cm) in one color family — all gold or all silver.
Mix weights: a fine chain, a curb chain, a statement pendant. The eye loves contrast.
On the same hand, play with placement: a thin ring on each phalanx, a more structured signet as punctuation.
Stay in one consistent finish and remember: fewer rings at the office in the morning, all of them at night.
Turtleneck or updo: hoops and drop earrings reveal the neckline.
With a plunging neckline, prefer discreet studs to avoid overloading the silhouette.

types-bijoux.title: Types of jewelry
types-bijoux.intro: Necklace, pendant, set? A small glossary to choose wisely.

p: The necklace is the chain; the pendant is the piece hanging from it. Choker (40 cm), princess (45 cm) or sautoir (over 70 cm): length changes everything.
Thin band, solitaire, signet or charm ring: the shape structures the hand. ORAYA sizes range from 48 to 60.
Bangle, chain, cord or cuff: the bracelet punctuates the wrist. Stack without moderation.
Studs, hoops, drops or magnetic sleepers: enough to vary from office to evening.
The necklace + earrings combination (sometimes a bracelet): the assured option for big occasions and exceptional gifts.
